name: Please, don't trust me
source:
Park Il-jae is a member of the currently popular music group consisting of five members. The guys wanted to celebrate the successful release of their new album with some delicious food, so Il-jae and his friend Kim Yeong-Hon set off for tteokbokki. The evening promised to be great, as the guys even learned that their album had achieved high sales. However, suddenly they encountered a strange girl from the stall where they were buying tteokbokki...

[From [url=https://lazypotat.itch.io/please-dont-trust-me]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
朴一宰是当红五人组合的成员。为了庆祝新专辑顺利发行，几个伙伴想吃顿好的，他便跟好友金永勋一起去买辣炒年糕。刚听说专辑卖出了好成绩，大家还以为这注定是个愉快的夜晚。谁知在卖年糕的摊位旁，两人遇上了一个奇怪的女孩…
